eventMetadata.context_description: Spain and France lead the 2026 World Cup winner market at near-identical implied probabilities due to their unmatched recent international pedigree. Spain captured Euro 2024, the 2022-23 Nations League, and Olympic gold while integrating elite young talent, while France reached the past two finals with one of the deepest squads. England and Portugal sit just behind on the strength of flawless qualification campaigns and consistent depth. Defending champion Argentina and Brazil remain competitive on historical pedigree and attacking quality, yet the tight clustering among the top six reflects how evenly matched these sides are heading into the expanded 48-team tournament, where group-stage results and knockout matchups can quickly shift momentum.
